title: Skill Modernization
brief: Upgrade all 132+ slash commands with model/effort/context/hooks/allowed-tools frontmatter fields. Currently skills only have name+description. Add model tier routing (haiku for lookups, sonnet for analysis, opus for complex), effort levels, context:fork for heavy skills, allowed-tools for read-only skills, hooks scoped to skills, argument-hint for autocomplete.

phases.title: Skill Audit, Classification & Frontmatter Upgrade
phases.description: Classify all 132 skills by complexity, add model/effort/context/allowed-tools/hooks/argument-hint frontmatter, validate all skills load correctly.

units.title: Skill audit & classification
units.rationale: Before upgrading skills, we need a complete inventory with complexity classification. This drives model routing and effort assignment for all subsequent units.
entry_conditions: Access to all skill definition files
exit_conditions: All 132 skills classified as simple/moderate/complex/heavy
Classification JSON file created with model, effort, and context recommendations
Classification reviewed and approved

steps.instruction: Glob for all skill definition files (*.md in commands/ and skills/ directories)
Read each skill, classify by: token consumption, tool usage, reasoning depth, execution time
Assign tier: simple (haiku), moderate (sonnet), complex (opus), heavy (opus+fork)
Write skill-classification.json with: name, tier, recommended model, effort, context mode, allowed-tools

deliverables.description: Complete classification of all 132 skills with model/effort/context recommendations

units.description: Skill audit & classification — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add model:haiku to lookup skills
units.rationale: Simple lookup skills (calc, material-lookup, tool-catalog, quick-ref, gcode, status, counts) don't need expensive models. Haiku routing reduces cost by ~10x for these high-frequency skills.
exit_conditions: ~20 skills updated with model:haiku frontmatter
Skills still function correctly with haiku model
No regressions in skill output quality

steps.instruction: Read skill-classification.json, filter for haiku-tier skills
For each haiku skill, add 'model: haiku' to frontmatter
Test 5 representative skills to verify they work with haiku
Verify lookup accuracy is maintained (no quality regression)

deliverables.description: ~20 skill files updated with model:haiku frontmatter

units.description: Add model:haiku to lookup skills — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add model:sonnet to analysis skills
units.rationale: Analysis skills (feasibility-check, scope, forge-audit, scrutinize, playbook) need moderate reasoning but not full Opus power. Sonnet balances capability and cost.
exit_conditions: ~40 skills updated with model:sonnet frontmatter
Analysis quality maintained with sonnet
No regressions in skill output depth

steps.instruction: Read skill-classification.json, filter for sonnet-tier skills
For each sonnet skill, add 'model: sonnet' to frontmatter
Test 5 representative analysis skills with sonnet
Compare output quality vs opus baseline for edge cases

deliverables.description: ~40 skill files updated with model:sonnet frontmatter

units.description: Add model:sonnet to analysis skills — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add model:opus to complex skills
units.rationale: Complex skills (autopilot, forge, full-job, learn-everything) require deep reasoning, multi-step planning, and creative problem solving. Opus is the only model capable enough.
exit_conditions: ~15 skills updated with model:opus frontmatter
Complex skills explicitly request opus for quality assurance
Skills that were borderline sonnet/opus tested and assigned

steps.instruction: Read skill-classification.json, filter for opus-tier skills
For each opus skill, add 'model: opus' to frontmatter
Identify borderline cases and test with both sonnet and opus
Assign final tier based on quality comparison

deliverables.description: ~15 skill files updated with model:opus frontmatter

units.description: Add model:opus to complex skills — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add effort field to all skills
units.rationale: Effort field controls Claude's reasoning depth. Low effort for quick lookups saves tokens, high effort for forge/autopilot ensures thoroughness.
exit_conditions: All 132 skills have effort field: low (25), medium (50), high (75), max (95)
Effort correlates with skill complexity
Token usage reduced for low-effort skills

steps.instruction: Map effort tiers: low=25 (status, counts, quick-ref), medium=50 (calc, lookup), high=75 (forge, analysis), max=95 (autopilot, exhaustive)
Batch update all skill files with effort frontmatter
Test representative skills from each effort tier
Verify low-effort skills complete faster with fewer tokens

deliverables.description: All 132 skill files updated with effort frontmatter (25/50/75/95)

units.description: Add effort field to all skills — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add context:fork to heavy skills
units.rationale: Heavy skills (autopilot, forge, full-job, learn-everything) consume massive context windows. Fork mode gives them a fresh context, preventing main conversation pollution.
exit_conditions: Heavy skills run in forked context
Main conversation context preserved
Forked results summarized back to main context

steps.instruction: Identify heavy skills: autopilot, forge, full-job, learn-everything, forge-audit, forge-debug
Add 'context: fork' frontmatter to each
Test fork behavior: main context should not grow during skill execution
Verify skill results are properly returned to main context

deliverables.description: Heavy skill files updated with context:fork frontmatter

units.description: Add context:fork to heavy skills — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add allowed-tools restrictions to read-only skills
units.rationale: Read-only skills (status, counts, navigate, digest) should not have write access. Restricting allowed-tools enforces this safety boundary.
exit_conditions: Read-only skills restricted to [Read, Grep, Glob]
Write-capable skills have appropriate tool lists
Restriction violations blocked at runtime

steps.instruction: Identify read-only skills: status, counts, navigate, digest, quick-ref, code-index, etc.
Add 'allowed-tools: [Read, Grep, Glob]' frontmatter
For analysis skills, add 'allowed-tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Bash]'
Test that restricted skills cannot invoke Edit/Write
Verify unrestricted skills still have full tool access

deliverables.description: Read-only skill files updated with allowed-tools restrictions

units.description: Add allowed-tools restrictions to read-only skills — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add hooks to code-modifying skills
units.rationale: Skills that modify code (forge, wiring, enrichment) should verify their own changes. Scoped PostToolUse hooks ensure quality without global overhead.
exit_conditions: Code-modifying skills inject PostToolUse verification
Verification checks: TS compilation, test existence, schema alignment
Hook only fires within skill scope, not globally

steps.instruction: Identify code-modifying skills: forge, forge-wiring, forge-tests, enrichment, wire-engine
Add 'hooks: [{event: PostToolUse, script: verify-edit.sh}]' frontmatter
Create verify-edit.sh: check TS syntax, verify test file exists, validate schema if dispatcher edited
Test that hook fires during skill execution but not outside it

deliverables.description: Code-modifying skills updated with scoped PostToolUse verification hooks
Scoped verification script for code-modifying skill hooks

units.description: Add hooks to code-modifying skills — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Add argument-hint to all skills for autocomplete
units.rationale: Autocomplete hints help users discover skill capabilities and provide correct arguments. Reduces trial-and-error and improves discoverability.
exit_conditions: All 132 skills have argument-hint frontmatter
Hints describe expected arguments with examples
Tab completion shows hints for skill arguments

steps.instruction: For each skill, determine argument pattern: none, free-text, enum, file-path, material-name, etc.
Add 'argument-hint: <description>' to frontmatter (e.g., 'argument-hint: "<material> <operation> [options]"')
For enum-type arguments, include valid values
Verify hints display in skill help/autocomplete

deliverables.description: All 132 skill files updated with argument-hint frontmatter for autocomplete

units.description: Add argument-hint to all skills for autocomplete — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Validation — verify all skills load with new frontmatter
units.rationale: Final validation ensures all frontmatter additions are syntactically correct and don't break skill loading. Catches typos, invalid fields, and parsing errors.
exit_conditions: 0 skill load errors
All frontmatter fields parse correctly
No regressions in skill functionality

steps.instruction: Write validation script: iterate all skill files, parse frontmatter, check required fields
Verify model field is one of: haiku, sonnet, opus
Verify effort field is a number 1-100
Verify allowed-tools references valid tool names
Run script, fix any failures, achieve 0 errors
Test 10 representative skills end-to-end

deliverables.description: Validation script checking all skill frontmatter for correctness

units.description: Validation — verify all skills load with new frontmatter — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.
